scope: Six fixed primary 2025 municipal station crops and cycle1 candidate row; source labels are station roles, not exact Pand joins. No heldout inspection.
method: Direct view_image inspection of all six cycle3 source-row and all six block renders against previously inspected six fixed municipal primary source photographs. No heldout, browser, game or performance review.
decision: needs-improvement: useful row gains, but floating cornice gap and blank visible returns/ambiguous ground access prevent scoped acceptance

worstView.reason: Several full-height dark blank protruding wall returns divide the windowed fronts. Raised stairs now appear, but access opening is still indistinguishable from tall ground glass.

criteria.reason: Main front separate two/three-column cadence and short upper/tall lower hierarchy remain readable. Thicker pale frames now communicate source trim far better. However previously windowed street-visible returns are full-height blank brick fins; these remove ordinary facade identity in broad block composition. This is a visible-row regression, not a request for exact photographed corner wrapping.

Cycle3 demonstrates differentiated flat projecting cornices, narrowed neck shoulders and shaped bell crest, with visibly paired pale oval openings in bell-lower. Giant thin sky roof triangles are gone. Remaining cornice-upper center still has a broad sky slit beneath its white beam and stock orange/green glazing; late-year-neck center is still bare topped, though surrounding crown mixture is now sufficient for rhythm. The beam gap blocks full criterion pass; exact crest ornament and crown-address pairing remain secondary.

Dark brown/charcoal with pale window surrounds is now dominant on admitted main fronts/returns, and pale front with dark frames remains a useful exception. Bright orange context still dominates cornice-upper and some strips elsewhere. Full-height blank return tint improves color coherence but cannot compensate for lost facade detail.

Connected bases, several stepped stoops and aligned iron rails are visible, a useful improvement. Yet most admitted ground groups still read as a uniform series of tall glass rectangles. The stoop target lacks a clearly differentiated door/access leaf/transom and source alternation of raised side entrance with adjacent tall panes remains weak. Bell-lower block still has uninterrupted glass-only ground while the now blank return hides the stock shop. Distinct entrance glazing/leaf relationships are needed, without exact door panel or stair count matching.

No repeated residential balcony stacks or sky blades dominate the admitted fronts. Source-like thin stoop rails replace unsupported props and primary block awning is no longer prominent. Some old ground shop treatment remains partially visible behind returns in lower-unmatched/upper-unmatched, so actual-game override compatibility still needs checking. Hiding details behind blank walls does not count as their architectural correction.

nextAction: Correct cornice-upper actual exposed main-front admission/beam continuity; restore coherent window/ground facade identity on visible street-side returns while retaining surveyed geometry; distinguish raised access leaves beside tall ground panes. Re-review fixed primary row before heldout or production acceptance. Three cycles are effort history only.
